items: After we marked an overdue milestone completed last cycle while two tasks were still in_progress, I require my confirmation before update_record_by_field on nocodb.project_tracker.milestones.Status when the matched milestone Priority is P0.
I do not want nocodb.project_tracker.milestones.Status overdue overwritten to completed in a sync pass; that flip should come from the PMO review, not from a tasks-table read.
For nocodb.project_tracker.milestones.MilestoneId MS-001, require update_record_by_field.require_unique=true and confirm before changing Status because that milestone gates the website launch.

For the May review, I allow update_record_by_field on nocodb.project_tracker.milestones.Status from active to completed when the matched ProjectCode tasks are all nocodb.project_tracker.tasks.Status completed and require_unique=true matched the MilestoneId.
MS-001 can be auto-merged when the underlying tasks for its ProjectCode are completed and the milestone Priority is P1.
I still want escalation before flipping nocodb.project_tracker.milestones.Status overdue to completed, but the routine active-to-completed move on a P1 milestone does not need my sign-off.
